headline: Police aborted pursuit about 10 seconds before fatal crash, watchdog says
summary: Police terminated a car pursuit approximately 10 seconds before a fatal crash occurred. The vehicle involved was reportedly driving the wrong way down a dual carriageway. A watchdog is investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

headline: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
summary: Trade talks between the US and Canada have collapsed, escalating tensions. Donald Trump suggested Canada seeks the 'benefits' of being a US state. Canada's Prime Minister announced retaliatory tariffs, accusing the US of initiating a trade war.

headline: CrossCountry cancels 'almost all' UK services after power cut
summary: CrossCountry has cancelled nearly all its UK rail services due to a major power cut. Passengers are describing the widespread disruption as a 'worst case scenario'. The cancellations are causing significant travel chaos across the UK.

headline: Zelensky should be asked what he knew about government corruption, sacked minister tells BBC
summary: A recently sacked minister has called for President Zelensky to be questioned about government corruption. Mykhailo Fedorov made the statement in an interview with the BBC. The former official also advocated for wartime elections to be held in Ukraine.
